parent_objective: design bounded fixed-policy source runner after task-matrix branch synthesis
blocked_by: bounded runner scope must be designed before real source rollout collection
supersedes: broad rollout generation without runner budget and artifact contract

public_gates: M1510 must design bounded fixed-policy source rollout collection
M1510 must name checkpoint, source-family cap, max steps, snapshot steps, and artifact schema
M1510 must block training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, actor-input changes, and corpus export
M1510 must separate public runner smoke from candidate materialization claims
M1510 must route to runner implementation or record a blocker
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run broad rollout generation before bounding the runner
do not claim self-identification from runner plumbing

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: bounds the fixed-policy runner needed after rollout candidate scaffolding and branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if runner design cannot stay public and bounded
stop if checkpoint or policy inputs violate actor contract
stop if runner design cannot separate trace collection from candidate materialization
stop if design would export a training corpus

if trace collection fails source families, route to env-hook repair

admission_evidence: M1509 synthesis promoted the task-matrix infrastructure branch to bounded fixed-policy runner work
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up runner implementation or blocker manifest
next_stage_criteria: checkpoint and runner budget are explicit
snapshot and trace schema are explicit
next implementation or blocker is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1510 must design runner outputs that later allow current/recent/older-history separation; it does not test self-ID itself.
history_necessity_tests: trace collection must preserve T4/T5 history windows for later interventions
runner smoke must not claim history necessity without measured intervention outcomes
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: design only; no new temporal evidence generated.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If bounded runner design cannot preserve the evidence contract, record a blocker before broad rollout generation.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1509 synthesis justifies a bounded public fixed-policy runner design that collects source traces without training or corpus export.
success_criteria: design names checkpoint, runner budget, snapshot schema, and guardrails
design separates trace collection from candidate materialization
design blocks training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, and corpus export
design routes to implementation or records a blocker
failure_criteria: runner budget or checkpoint is ambiguous
design conflates trace collection with candidate materialization
design starts training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or corpus export
decision_rule: M1510 passes if it bounds fixed-policy runner scope before implementation or broad rollout generation.
